description: Data or comparison table. Wraps in a horizontal-scroll container whenever the table is wider than the band — at ANY viewport, not only on mobile: .table-wrap declares overflow-x: auto with no media query, and the table itself is width: max-content; min-width: 100%. Headers become <th scope='col'> elements.

id.description: Optional HTML id attribute for anchor linking (e.g. navigation anchors).

rows.description: Array of rows. Each row is an array of cell values. Rich HTML (sanitized via wp_kses_post): block markup, lists and links are allowed in a cell, the same contract as section.body.

caption.description: Accessible table caption (rendered as <caption>). Recommended for data tables.

--table-padding-top.description: Top padding of the band. Defaults to the shared symmetric band rhythm (fluid ~68-80px desktop, ~54px mobile); set an explicit length to override.

--table-padding-bottom.description: Bottom padding of the band. Defaults to the shared symmetric band rhythm; set an explicit length to override.

--table-heading-size.description: Section heading font size. Defaults to the shared responsive band-heading scale (fluid ~28px mobile to ~42px desktop), which every band heading in the theme routes. LEAVE IT UNSET unless THIS band must differ from the rest of the site: the shared scale is not a design token and no action in the write path can retune it, so setting this slot changes THIS band only and never the others.

--table-heading-color.description: Section heading color. Defaults to the theme text colour (table has no inverted variant — it declares no theme classes at all). LEAVE IT UNSET unless THIS band must differ: recolouring every heading on the site is ONE update_design_token write on --color-text, not one slot write per band.

--table-heading-measure.description: Maximum width of the table section heading. Routes the shared --measure-heading design token (40rem) by default, so retuning that ONE token changes every routed band heading at once; set a length here only when THIS band must differ from the rest of the site.

--table-heading-margin-bottom.description: Space below the table section heading, before the table (header rhythm). Lower it to tighten the header, raise it for more separation. Not a band-fusing lever: the table always renders after the heading, so the seam with the band below is closed with --table-padding-bottom.
